name: ga-p7-playability
description: GA Lab P7: can a small CPU-trained model predict how hard a guitar voicing is to play better than GA's hand-written cost?

scripts.ci: node scripts/synth-dataset.mjs --out out/synthetic.jsonl && node scripts/train.mjs --data out/synthetic.jsonl --out out/ci-measurements.json --budget ci && node scripts/check-annotations.mjs --out out/ci-annotations.json
